During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] launched a concerted '''assault''' on a [[Unidentified moon (Werta system)|moon]] in the [[Werta system/Legends|Werta system]] where a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Unidentified Rebel base (Werta system moon)|base]] had been discovered.<ref name="GaW" />
